data.narrative:
Solinftec is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $40M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 private peers (including Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics, and Dexterity, all Series B stage) and 1 public comparable, yielding two applicable triangulation methods.

The stage-progression method applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the $40M raised proxy, implying a $76M valuation. The peer-median approach derives valuation from three same-sector, same-stage comparables with a median valuation of $1.8B (range: $1.6B–$2.0B). The disparity between these methods reflects heterogeneity in comparable company maturity, revenue traction, and capital intensity within the robotics sector at Series B.

Triangulating across both methods produces a valuation range of $65M (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median of $913M. This wide range reflects material uncertainty around Solinftec's relative position within the peer set—specifically, whether the company's commercial traction and unit economics align with lower-capitalized entrants (suggesting the $65M–$76M range) or with better-capitalized, faster-scaling peers (suggesting the $1.6B–$2.0B range). Additional clarity on revenue run rate, gross margins, and customer concentration would sharpen this valuation estimate.
